integrationContract.shapeRef: relative SVG file path + fragment ID
integrationContract.instanceXY: existing source anchor, in mm; no recentering
integrationContract.namespaceImportedIds: Keep partId and instanceId stable. When copying whole source SVG DOM, namespace non-geometry IDs per instance to avoid annotations/center-mark collisions. The originals each have unique IDs; different files reuse annotations and center-mark.
integrationContract.render: Use only visible-outline group by default. Embed assets at build time or load by an explicit local file chooser. Do not rely on file:// fetch succeeding or start a permanent server.

packagingValidation.scope: Packaging checks only. Does not certify actual bodies, plugs, wires, operation, tolerances, strength or manufacturability.

embeddedManifest.knownRenderingIssue: The source SVG tessellation fills may cancel or disappear in some renderers; the packaging QA in Inkscape showed outline-dominant rendering. Source asset bytes and physical outlines are preserved. Use the original comparison PNG for colors/appearance; do not silently redraw or rescale geometry to repair fill display. The tool may apply simple presentation colors while preserving the original exact outline and source bytes; no geometry redraw or rescaling.

rules.instruction: Start from the 8-port appearance; remove former top 4 menu keys from baseline. Real plugs, support, wiring and menu functions are not approved by this adoption.

Keep center-to-center, projected X/Y gap and shortest outline distance separately named. Exclude annotation strokes, mounting candidates and SVG page whitespace. If a metric uses an AABB, call it an AABB gap, not an exact outline distance.

rules.measurementTarget: visible part outline vs current panel outline
rules.instruction: Show crossing or containment violations using the actual rounded panel. No invented all-around inset. An inside result is not a safety certificate.
